verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring traces live production LLM calls, tool calls, cost and errors, and can replay conversations. Nothing in the evidence shows evaluators, scoring, or LLM-as-judge running on production traffic or on offline datasets. Online evals are a fair question for an LLM observability product, so the axis applies; tracing and the 'catch unexpected output issues' marketing line are adjacent monitoring features, not evaluators.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets
